summary: Diff implements a runtime-config mechanism for backend canister ID (runtime-config.json + runtimeConfig utilities) and adds an Apache .htaccess for SPA routing. It also refactors frontend gating/error handling around backend connectivity. Some requirements around cPanel documentation completeness and IC deployment script improvements are not fully evidenced in the provided diff summary, and there are additional changes (not explicitly requested) such as extra .htaccess hardening/caching directives and backend canister-ID setter/getter logic.
